description:
Epic. The result-reporting guardrail. Because agents are nondeterministic, do NOT trust stdout or sentinel files — every agent reports its verdict by calling a single MCP tool, `report-check-result`, served by ONE in-process MCP server built with `rmcp`, bound to a localhost port, running on a dedicated tokio task within the CLI process (never a subprocess). Decomposed into the sub-tickets in this phase.

———
